{{Quote|And we did, though it may have taken months rather than days. When the fighting ended, Mon Mothma and I escorted Sian Tevv into the government center for his ceremonial inauguration.|Gial Ackbar, in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''|<ref name="Rebel Files" />}}
The '''Liberation of Sullust''' was a battle following the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> where the [[New Republic]]<ref name="Siege 4" /> liberated the [[planet]] [[Sullust]] from the [[Galactic Empire]] after [[Standard month|months]] of fighting. After the battle, [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]] and [[Mon Mothma]] escorted [[Councillor]] [[Sian Tevv]] into the government center for his ceremonial inauguration.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

Despite the liberation, Imperial forces made use of an [[abandoned weapons depot]] on Sullust. During the [[Destruction of an abandoned weapons depot|infiltration of the depot]], [[Shriv Suurgav]] assured [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] that he was familiar with Sullust, having taken part in its liberation.<ref name="SWBF2" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' puts the Liberation of Sullust in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> However, its mention within [[Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege 4|''Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege'' 4]] push the battle back to [[5 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' framed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as taking part in the battle,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> but ''Republic Under Siege'' 4 establishes that the Alliance was by that point the New Republic.<ref name="Siege 4" />
